name: 海洋2000
english_description: The in-game title is Ocean II -- an ES2/Jin Yong-themed mudlib belonging to the "Ocean/hy" code family alongside fqyy2 (Storm Clouds Rising II) in this project, both routing SECURITY_D to adm/daemons/securd.lpc and both authenticating admins through a backdoor id hardcoded into that same daemon rather than a plain-text wizlist (here, "wuyou"). It is also the base for hy2002, a superset that adds roughly 3,000 more files (new maps, new sect content) on top of an otherwise identical 10,630-file map. The world layers a marriage system (d/marry/, d/happy/) on top of the standard Huashan/Wudang/Shaolin/Beggars'-Sect sect map. Registration leads to a working bulletin-board post/look chain, NPC patrols on the map from the very first zone, and a leaderboard item that spawns on every logout.
